name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 41 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-11-24, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.18 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
